decisive_items: pleomorphic hyperchromatic tumor cells with moderate cytoplasm, round to oval nuclei
response.rationale: The histologic features (trabecular/rosette-like, pleomorphic cells, high mitotic rate) and advanced pelvic spread with elevated CA-125 are most consistent with high-grade serous carcinoma. R3 is less likely given age and nonspecific NSE elevation; R2 is too broad.

rejected.why: Small cell carcinoma of the ovary is rare, typically in younger women, and NSE elevation is nonspecific; histology lacks classic small-cell features.
Ovarian cancer is a generic category; the specific histologic pattern and clinical presentation favor high-grade serous carcinoma.
